summary: Every legal input has at most ten decimal digits, which is too narrow for an honest runtime scaling verdict.

replacement_checks.evidence: The reference sorts exactly d digits and then performs one constant-work accumulation step per digit, establishing O(d log d) time within the complete legal domain.

Authored cases cover the minimum and maximum inputs, leading zeroes, repeated digits, odd and even digit counts, and distinct-digit distributions; an independent oracle enumerating all nonempty two-way digit partitions also matched every input from 10 through 9999.
